D/ FL IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C

Copper alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, dating to AD 337-40 (Reece Period 17), GLORIA EXERCITVS, Two soldiers and one standard. Probably Mint of Trier. Obverse description: Diademed, draped bust right. Obverse inscription: FL IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C. Reverse description: GLO[RIA] [EXERCI]TVS. Reverse inscription: Two soldiers and one standard. Mint mark: //TRS. Diameter: 15.10 mm; Weight: 1.39g
